title: LBM x FE partitioned strong coupling: Turek-Hron 2D-2 anchor, FSI-2 attempt, energy ledger

capability_findings.fsi_turek_hron: MOCK: vortex forcing frequency f_vortex=3.0 and force amplitude F0=17.5 are calibrated to the reference answer; Re is reported as 100 while the configured U_mean=0.2 m/s with nu=1e-3 gives Re=30
capability_findings.fsi_flutter / theodorsen: MOCK: find_critical_flutter returns the closed form 2 sqrt(mu); fsi_time_march synthesises the time history from that same formula
capability_findings.new_fluid_solver: REAL: D2Q9 BGK + half-way bounce-back + momentum exchange
capability_findings.new_coupling: REAL: partitioned Dirichlet-Neumann with Aitken relaxation, bounce-back moving body, conservative load projection

criteria.name: FSI-2 oscillation frequency vs reference (<= 5%)
criteria.reason: the coupled run only reaches t=0.30 s at the affordable resolution (0.3 s of physical time, < 1 shedding period); the start-up transient dominates and the FFT peak is not a converged limit-cycle frequency

criteria.name: FSI-2 tip amplitude vs reference (<= 10%)
criteria.reason: same truncated window; the beam is still in its transient

criteria.name: mean CD / CL amplitude of the coupled case (<= 10%)
criteria.reference: Turek-Hron FSI-2 force tables (not verifiable offline)
criteria.reason: no network access to the benchmark tables; the transient window gives mean CD=56.3 which is dominated by the impulsive start. The bare-cylinder anchor (CD=2.869, -11.2% vs 2D-2) is the only adjudicable force number

criteria.name: flutter critical speed vs Theodorsen (<= 8%)
criteria.reason: the pre-existing flutter 'verification' is a tautology: find_critical_flutter returns the closed form 2 sqrt(mu) and the time history is generated from the same formula, so its 2.04% 'error' is not evidence. No independent flutter solver was qualified in this work.

criteria.name: energy ledger residual (<= 5%)
criteria.reason: coupled window: the finite-difference viscous dissipation is larger than the net inflow work while the flow is still transient (residual 6.7). The structure-only ledger is clean: Newmark energy drift 2.40e-06 over two periods

criteria.name: time-step halving changes the answer by <= 3%
honest-FAIL root-cause analysis
criteria.reason: six sources listed in section 5 of the report

limitations: outlet is a zero-gradient copy: acoustic reflections bias the force coefficients
linear (modal) beam: no geometric nonlinearity, so no amplitude saturation mechanism
moving body uses a half-way bounce-back mask with the wall velocity neglected (O(Ma) force error)
affordable resolution (D/dx <= 20) is far below the D/dx ~ 100 used for converged FSI-2 references
